authoring.identity: No defined profession; maximum trait flexibility.
authoring.starting_experience: No profession Knowledge. Neutral starting Skill biases.
authoring.design_note: Balance Revision 3: deliberately grants no starting Skill strengths, Skill weaknesses, or profession Knowledge. Its compensation is maximum Trait flexibility; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free background.

authoring.identity: Physical conditioning, exercise discipline, body awareness.
authoring.starting_experience: Strong physical starting bias; no automatic medical/technical Knowledge.
authoring.design_note: The blocked habit traits define the REBIRTH archetype, not a claim about every real personal trainer. Balance Revision 3: profession package uses capped positive starting Skills plus explicit negative Skill weaknesses; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free baseline.

authoring.identity: Emergency field medicine and crisis response.
authoring.starting_experience: Emergency Medicine Knowledge; strong Medicine bias.
authoring.design_note: Can still be physically weak/strong; medical knowledge is learned experience, not Constitution. Balance Revision 3: profession package uses capped positive starting Skills plus explicit negative Skill weaknesses; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free baseline.

authoring.identity: Medication, dosing, formulation, and applied pharmaceutical chemistry.
authoring.starting_experience: Medication Knowledge + Chemistry Basics; strong Chemistry bias and useful Medicine bias.
authoring.design_note: Pharmacist is the applied medicine/chemistry specialist. Chemistry Station advantages should apply especially to pharmaceutical and medical chemistry recipes; Lab Technician remains the broader laboratory/analysis specialist.

authoring.identity: Chemistry, careful procedure, technical analysis.
authoring.starting_experience: Chemistry Basics Knowledge; modest technical Skill bias.
authoring.design_note: Advanced chemistry still requires Knowledge/workstations/recipes. Balance Revision 3: profession package uses capped positive starting Skills plus explicit negative Skill weaknesses; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free baseline.

authoring.identity: Information organization, research habits, and patient public service.
authoring.starting_experience: Broad learning-oriented Trait access; no specialist Knowledge is granted automatically.
authoring.design_note: Reuses the existing general-learning Trait family; Librarian does not auto-unlock recipes, magazines, or specialist Knowledge. Balance Revision 3: profession package uses capped positive starting Skills plus explicit negative Skill weaknesses; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free baseline.

authoring.identity: Vehicles, engines, vehicle systems, roadside service, and vehicle restoration.
authoring.starting_experience: Vehicle Service Knowledge; strong vehicle-focused Mechanics bias with supporting Maintenance.
authoring.design_note: Mechanic owns vehicles and engines. General equipment/facility repair belongs to Maintenance Technician; material recovery belongs to Scavenger.

authoring.identity: Generators, power systems, electrical repair.
authoring.starting_experience: Electrical Fundamentals Knowledge.
authoring.design_note: No invented wiring minigame; effects attach to generators, powered blocks, repair, and authored electrical Knowledge. Balance Revision 3: profession package uses capped positive starting Skills plus explicit negative Skill weaknesses; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free baseline.

authoring.identity: General construction, framing/carpentry, structural repair, upgrades, and physical site work.
authoring.starting_experience: Basic Construction + Basic Carpentry Knowledge; strong Construction and practical tool bias.
authoring.design_note: Construction Worker is the umbrella building trade. Carpenter and Framer are intentionally folded into this background rather than maintained as separate Experiences.

authoring.identity: Metal fabrication, welding, forge work, structural metal components, and practical metal repair.
authoring.starting_experience: Metalworking Knowledge; strong Metalworking bias with practical Maintenance/Construction crossover.
authoring.design_note: Display identity broadened from Welder / Fabricator to Metal Worker while retaining the stable background.welder_fabricator ID for profile compatibility. Owns practical metal fabrication/forge work, not vehicle mechanics, general maintenance, or gunsmithing.

authoring.identity: General equipment, tool, appliance, and facility repair and upkeep.
authoring.starting_experience: General Maintenance Knowledge; strongest broad non-vehicle repair bias.
authoring.design_note: Maintenance Technician is the general repair specialist. It intentionally excludes vehicle specialization (Mechanic), structural construction (Construction Worker), electrical specialization (Electrician), and salvage/resource recovery (Scavenger).

authoring.identity: Systems knowledge and planning rather than instant craftsmanship.
authoring.starting_experience: Electrical Fundamentals + Technical Diagnostics Knowledge; modest practical skills.
authoring.design_note: Deliberately separates theory/Knowledge from hands-on Skill. Balance Revision 3: profession package uses capped positive starting Skills plus explicit negative Skill weaknesses; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free baseline.

authoring.identity: Ore extraction, digging, sustained tool work.
authoring.starting_experience: Strong mining/tool bias; no advanced manufacturing Knowledge.
authoring.design_note: Progression sources are actual ore/block work; trivial block spam must be anti-grind limited. Balance Revision 3: profession package uses capped positive starting Skills plus explicit negative Skill weaknesses; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free baseline.

authoring.identity: Axe work, wood harvesting, sustained labor.
authoring.starting_experience: Strong axe/wood-harvest bias.
authoring.design_note: Uses real axe/block harvest actions. Balance Revision 3: profession package uses capped positive starting Skills plus explicit negative Skill weaknesses; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free baseline.

authoring.identity: Physical emergency response and heat exposure.

authoring.design_note: No carrying-rescue mechanic is assumed. Balance Revision 3: profession package uses capped positive starting Skills plus explicit negative Skill weaknesses; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free baseline.

authoring.identity: Prepared food, recipe execution, food quality.
authoring.starting_experience: Cooking Knowledge and strong Cooking bias.

authoring.identity: Clothing, textiles, leather, wearable goods, backpacks, pouches, and soft-equipment construction and repair.
authoring.starting_experience: Basic Tailoring Knowledge; strong Tailoring bias with modest general repair crossover.
authoring.design_note: Tailor is the umbrella soft-goods profession. It covers practical sewing, cloth/leather work, clothing repair, pockets/pouches, backpacks, straps, padding, and basic footwear without creating separate Leatherworker/Cobbler backgrounds. Tailoring recipe/LBD routing is NEW REBIRTH work where no native hook exists.

authoring.identity: Crop production and Advanced Farming familiarity.
authoring.starting_experience: Farming Knowledge; strong Farming bias.
authoring.design_note: Uses existing base/REBIRTH crop, water, fertilizer, and harvest systems. Balance Revision 3: profession package uses capped positive starting Skills plus explicit negative Skill weaknesses; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free baseline.

authoring.starting_experience: Animal-processing Knowledge; modest Cooking bias.
authoring.design_note: Meat-Centric Palate conflicts with Vegetarian/Vegan, but the Background itself does not. Balance Revision 3: profession package uses capped positive starting Skills plus explicit negative Skill weaknesses; Clean Slate is the only weakness-free baseline.
